validation.browserEvidence: This batch passed 33 browser cases across all three engines: 12 native template layout, no-plot pane and formatter cases, 18 example-host template cases and three original autofit regressions. Actual built-site checks passed 30 states across desktop and 390-pixel layouts, including all four template controls. Data, source identity, copied values, pane weights, scale ownership, ranges, axis placement and rendered pixels were checked. Final engine, host and built-site screenshots were inspected. Traffic uses fixtures rather than live brokers.
validation.website: 63 static pages built successfully; template example verified through initial state and all four controls at desktop and mobile widths in all three engines
validation.budgetChange: Typed scalar validation, paired exchange defaults and targeted capture fences add 1025 bytes to base (110469 to 111494) and 1.12 KiB to chart-only (69.59 to 70.71). Shared typed forms and modal actions add 2032 bytes to the optional widget (60158 to 62190). Numerical window and finite-result corrections add 106 bytes to indicators (35895 to 36001). Limits: base 111.75 kB, base plus trade 119.75 kB, indicators 36.1 kB, widget 62.25 kB, terminal 251.5 kB, all 294 kB and chart-only 70.85 KiB. Other tier limits unchanged.
validation.review: Independent typed-input review found reentrant destruction, pane-slot replacement and context changes during pick:end. Eight actual-chart regressions failed before capture lifetime fences and now pass. No additional blocker found in scalar validation, exchange defaults, restore preflight or public exports. A final host review reproduced four failures involving constructor and __proto__ exchange keys; safe own-property defaults, patches and staged collection now preserve them through selection, Defaults, Cancel and Apply.
validation.packageVerification: Full verify passes lint, typecheck, 7480 unit tests, seven endurance checks, build, 472 example-host tests, declaration identity, measured size budgets and optional-tier removal checks. Installed companion 0.7.0 passes 18 compiled-program integration checks and public adapter typechecking. API documentation generates without warnings.
validation.latestEngineSourceReview: Companion source f9ab00e4e9238b442ae0ad3639f52bc5dc45394b passes 2161 JavaScript tests, 956 Python tests and 102 conformance cases, with 19 compiler-only skips. Strict gates pass 6836 cases and 1504908 accepted calls with zero exact-bit, absence, oracle or execution differences. Both public 0.7.0 packages are published. Downloaded public artifacts pass 363 programs across all 116 keys, 124977 exact cells and 6756 independent expected cells. Archived source/build bytes and registry integrity match; attestation digest/source/workflow claims checked without cryptographic signature verification.
validation.directionalSeedAudit: 129 focused tests pass after aligning directional-movement seeds with true range. Built-package exact-value and rendered-line checks pass in all three browser engines; screenshots inspected. First-available indices and existing chart missing-value behavior are preserved. See numerical-audit.md for the independent fixture and remaining limits.
validation.hullLengthAudit: 173 focused tests and six browser cases across three engines pass. Standalone HMA now shares Hull Suite's integer half and rounded square-root windows, with length one as identity. Six compiled Hull fixtures match chart formulas and availability within 1e-12, while all fifteen audited compiled programs agree bit-for-bit between the companion engines. Chart summation order and missing-value contracts remain under audit.
validation.widerNumericalProbe: All 105 descriptors and 266 outputs were executed through 1148 compiled cases, covering 1287674 companion-engine cells and 86866 independent table cells. Recorded companion runs have zero differences. After the RSI correction, 197 outputs differ in at least one exercised policy or arithmetic case, 38 agree on tested finite inputs, 27 are constant, two are table carriers and two broad-absent Halftrend signals have finite independent fixtures. The post-correction event/calendar supplement passes all 70 compiled programs, 104954 cross-engine cells and 86866 independent table cells; 16 of its 58 outputs match exactly within the exercised native corpus and 36 still differ, with constants and carriers counted separately. Other recursive gap policies, CPR period extrema and arithmetic-order differences remain under review; this is not a universal native parity claim.
